text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to get the win today and show
Zephyr
that even the highest walls can
be conquered!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure that'll be enough to give her
courage!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower is itching to go. She
seems to get incredibly motivated when
she's doing something
to help out
others.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm positive she'll show me some great
running
today!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(I'm sure the challenge she's decided on
is much
harder than what I face.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(I don't know if I can help her. But I do
know that
I want to try.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(After all, everyone needs someone to
pick them
up when they're down.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(I want to be that for her. She's so cool,
working
so hard for someone else's sake.
I want to cheer
her on.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I hope my feelings reach you, Zephyr!
